content.en: Digital money represents a **digital representation of value** that functions as a medium of exchange, unit of account, and store of value. Unlike physical currency, it exists exclusively in electronic databases. In the Indian economy, this encompasses various forms including electronic bank deposits, digital wallets, and central bank-backed digital currencies.
